title.narrative: Credit and Financial Services: North Kivu Agriculture Sector Support Project

description.narrative: The main objective of PASA-NK is to sustainably improve food security and incomes among participating households. The development objective is to improve productivity and profitability for four crops produced by smallholders ' maize, rice, potato and Arabica coffee.
